summary: HDFC Bank Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a disclosure to the New York Stock Exchange regarding its quarterly business update for the June 2026 quarter. The filing includes key business volumes such as advances under management (average ~30,386 billion, up 10.8% YoY), gross advances (period end ~30,610 billion, up 15.4% YoY), and deposits (average ~30,114 billion, up 13.3% YoY), among other metrics. No transaction, shareholder vote, or material definitive agreement is involved. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms. The results will be subject to limited review by statutory auditors. This is a routine current report; no further action or risk-arb angle arises.
